title: Closing the interview
summary: Interviewer closes and plans a second session.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: I've been sweating you for almost two hours, and I think we're going to call it today, and thank you so very much, because I realize I've just begun to scratch the surface of all your store of knowledge. We had hoped to have Bud, Loyer County, in on this, but he lives across the river, and I couldn't get over there. I have an obstetrical case that may bust loose. So we're going to resume this another time when we can have the two of them together, Arnold, Loyer County, and Bud, where they will probably stimulate each other into much more memories than we have. Now, surely, thank you.
Yeah. You bring up some names that I don't know, I guess. Thanks again, Arnold. You're entirely welcome, Doc.
